responsibility: Declares record_layout, the analyzer utility for representing the concrete bit-level layout of a RECORD_TYPE as a vector of items. The interface defines per-item metadata for either a real field or padding-after-field, exposes dumping and offset lookup APIs, and serves layout-aware analyzer code that needs to relate memory offsets back to source fields and padding within structs.
same_name_distinction: Defines the record_layout and nested item interface for representing struct fields and padding, whereas record-layout.cc performs the actual RECORD_TYPE traversal and construction of those layout items.
